name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::end, std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::cend
intro:
Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the flat_multimap.

This element acts as a placeholder; attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Iterator to the element following the last element.
